doc: Trend Template (Mark Minervini, Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard, McGraw-Hill 2013). A stage-2 uptrend candidate meets all of: price above the 150-day and 200-day SMAs; 150-day above 200-day; 200-day rising for at least a month; 50-day above 150-day and 200-day; price above the 50-day; price at least 30% above its 52-week low; price within 25% of its 52-week high; relative strength rating of 70 or more. This preset draws the SMAs 50, 150 and 200 and the 52-week high and low (the highest high and lowest low of the last 252 bars; on fewer bars, the bars so far) with a volume pane, so the moving-average and 52-week conditions can be read off. The 30% and 25% distances and the relative strength rating (a rank against other stocks) are not drawn.
